law: Your extension manages a custom view controller, which you use to present the content from incoming notifications.
You can use your view controller to: Customize the placement of items, including the alert’s title, subtitle, and body text.
The system always displays a header that includes the app name and icon.
If the notification category includes custom actions, the system automatically adds action buttons to your notification interface; don’t create those buttons yourself.
Do not install gesture recognizers or rely on touch events in your interface.
